newsitem.title: USA: California Microwave chief exec resigns.
newsitem.headline: California Microwave chief exec resigns.

text.p: California Microwave Inc said Friday Philip F. Otto has resigned as chairman and chief executive officer and as a director of the company to pursue other interests.

David B. Leeson, the founder of the company, was appointed chairman of the board and of a newly-formed Executive Committee comprised of Leeson, Edward E. David Jr., Alfred M. Gray and Frederick W. Whitridge Jr., California Microwave said in a brief statement that provided no further details.

It did say "We are fortunate that Phil has agreed to make himself available as a consultant to the company to provide necessary continuity during the forthcoming transition period." -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
